mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL and SPX returns over the horizon is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within the last month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE changes and SPX returns over the horizon is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the past two months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between RSAFS changes and SPX returns over the horizon is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the past two months signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO changes and SPX returns over the horizon is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on SPX returns over the horizon is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) are increasing, the combination signals a tight labor market with strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with strong job growth
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint effect of UNRATE and PAYEMS on SPX returns over the horizon is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past two months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between HOUST changes and SPX returns over the horizon is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 changes and SPX returns over the horizon is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
